Analyst assignment, frozen BaoStock case typed-completion-adaptive-05 (adaptive variant). Research question: develop an executable short-horizon close-momentum hypothesis for later independent evaluation; baseline is the five-observation raw return (candidate:1: expression 1*(close[t]/close[t-5]-1), direction +1, normalization none, no return-magnitude exclusion). All sources are inline on the case board; read them (source:source_contract, source:research_contract, source:data_quality, source:price_profile, source:initial_inspection, and the three price CSVs as needed). Produce findings covering exactly these three areas, keeping every hypothesis unproven (no alpha, superiority, or tradability claims):
(1) Baseline semantics and executability: signal computed only from closes at/before t; six trailing closes required (five warm-up exclusions per symbol); execution no earlier than the next observed close, so the last-row signal has no execution observation; no filling of absent dates.
(2) Source-supported applicability constraints: unadjusted close-only data with no volume, corporate actions, calendar, transaction costs, or point-in-time universe; close-only jumps cannot identify corporate actions and cannot justify a jump/corporate-action screen; current download is not a vintage archive; convenience sample of three symbols; observations are exploratory development data, never a holdout; no forward labels exist.
(3) Alternative-specification motivation, at most one: use the observed price/return profiles to characterize (via current_fact_refs, no numeric copies) the cross-symbol dispersion in one-observation return scale and in the baseline score scale per symbol, note the zero-return observation and what it implies for a trailing realized-volatility normalization (requires positive trailing SD), and weigh exactly one alternative drawn from the allowed FactorSpec schema (lookback 2-20; direction ±1; normalization none or realized_volatility with volatility_window 5-20; max_absolute_daily_return up to 0.5). State the trade-offs (added parameter, lost eligible signals to warm-up, score-scale consequences) and what evidence a future independent evaluation would need. Do not prescribe a winner; a coherent retention of the baseline is equally acceptable. Submit via submit_case_findings per the structured-v3/typed-v1 contract (qualitative statements with fact_refs; no numeric copies or count equations), then end on the reserved acknowledgement.
